item_verdicts.title: Metal clang (armor/parry) = inharmonic square-bank OR fast-decay inharmonic FM; both are plain-node, fully parameterizable
item_verdicts.why: Sonoport page verified to contain the exact hi-hat numbers claimed (fundamental 40, ratios [2, 3, 4.16, 5.43, 6.79, 8.21], bandpass 10000, highpass 7000, stop at +0.05s). WAC-2016 repo verified to state 'FM does a better job of synthesizing metallic sounds... than subtractive synthesis' with carrier >1000 Hz, non-integer modulator ratio, depth over ~1000. The grade-C Nail The Mix source was not fetched, but the claim stands fully on the two verified B sources.

item_verdicts.title: Flesh/body thud = 3-layer percussion recipe: pitch-dropping low tone + short mid attack tone + lowpassed noise burst
item_verdicts.why: Sonoport kick verified exactly: frequency setValueAtTime(120)→exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, +0.5) with gain 1→0.001 over the same 0.5s — including the 0.001-floor detail the implementation_note relies on (exponentialRamp cannot hit 0). WAC-2016 snare verified: tone1 low triangle + tone2 midrange with 'much more pronounced envelope decay' + noise through 'a lowpass filter with a low Q' — the lowpass-low-Q attribution is correctly pinned to WAC, not Sonoport (whose snare uses a highpass). Repo: 'flesh (hitLanded)' is Stage 6 item 1 verbatim; INFERRED labeling rule confirmed in src/config/CLAUDE.md. Pixflow (grade C) unfetched but non-load-bearing.

item_verdicts.title: Anti-repetition: per-play pitch jitter around +-20% plus slight gain jitter, applied at the render-layer SFX player
item_verdicts.why: The architecture half is fully confirmed against the repo: src/game/CLAUDE.md mandates render-only scenes draining SimEvent[] into FX/SFX, and src/game/DuelScene.ts ALREADY calls Math.random() for blood spray ('Math.random is banned in core/' per its own comment), so per-play jitter in the SFX player is precedented and legal. But two attributions fail attack. (1) The ±20% figure: none of the three cited sources contains it — the bugnet page contains ZERO numeric values anywhere (verified with a list-every-number fetch; the '±20% pitch, >=6 variations' source annotation is fabricated), gameaudiolearning describes min/max pitch randomization only qualitatively, and asoundeffect gives no pitch bound. (2) tests/config-purity.test.ts contains no Math.random check — it enforces zero numeric literals and import purity in src/core only; the Math.random ban is a src/core/CLAUDE.md invariant, not test-enforced (Math is a global, so the import scan can't catch it).
item_verdicts.correction: Replace the bugnet source annotation and drop the '±20% is the repeatedly cited baseline' framing: all three cited sources support pitch/volume randomization + no-immediate-repeat only QUALITATIVELY, with no numeric bound (bugnet's page has no numbers at all). Seed pitchJitterPct 0.10-0.20 as a plain INFERRED guess. Also correct the enforcement citation: the no-Math.random rule in core is a src/core/CLAUDE.md invariant (plus comments in Sim.ts/rng.test.ts), NOT enforced by tests/config-purity.test.ts — that test checks numeric literals and import resolution only. The ADOPT itself stands: src/game already uses Math.random (DuelScene blood spray) and is the correct jitter layer.

item_verdicts.title: Karplus-Strong / AudioWorklet string synthesis for the clang: skip it
item_verdicts.why: The karplus-stress-tester page verified: it exists and states AudioWorklet per-node overhead is measurable ('fewer AudioWorklet nodes... is more performant'), Wasm 'is more performant', and SharedArrayBuffer is the '(better)' messaging option because MessagePort 'creates garbage via memory allocations' — matching the citation, and consistent with dead_ends' honest omission of the unverified 128-sample claim. Repo: MASTER_SPEC Stage 6 names exactly four SFX + two music beds + victory/defeat stings and NO UI tick, as claimed; the src/config/CLAUDE.md landmine exists near-verbatim ('Don't invent constants that "feel missing"... Stage specs name every constant; follow them exactly' — the item paraphrases 'constants/systems' where the text says constants, immaterial). Item 2's plain-node alternative was independently confirmed, so the REJECT's premise holds. mrahtz repo (grade C) unfetched; non-load-bearing.
